| Category | Years in which it exceeded $100 million |
|----------|----------------------------------------|
| **Housing** | 2000 ($130,547,904.17), 2002 ($136,069,573.15), 2003 ($121,262,201.93), 2004 ($174,233,061.24) |
| **Redevelopment** | 2002 ($181,037,125.84), 2003 ($227,160,561.02), 2004 ($162,102,812.82) |
| **Business Recruitment** | 2000 ($101,460,962.91) |

These categories are the only ones that surpassed the $100 million threshold in any single year within the 2000‑2004 period. No other listed categories reached that level during those years.
